Description
Investing in the Valcambi 100 Gram Gold Bar is wise for those seeking a secure and stable investment option. With its increasing value over time, Valcambi cast gold bar is an excellent way to safeguard your financial future. Optimizing your investment portfolio with the 100g Valcambi gold bar ensures you are well-positioned to weather any economic changes and protect your wealth.
The Valcambi 100 Gram Gold Bar is crafted with investment-grade gold bar has a purity of 99.99%, and comes with an assay certificate to guarantee its authenticity. The Valcambi 100 Gram Gold Bar is not just a tangible asset but a symbol of financial stability that can be easily liquidated in times of need.
Description
Investing in the physical gold bar is the most satisfying investment because of the reputation gold holds and the high liquidity of gold in the market. Owning smaller quantities of gold is the perfect window to own .9999 pure gold at low premiums and build your gold portfolio. Bullion Trading LLC introduces a gorgeous gold bar from the most renowned refinery in the bullion market- the 100 Gram Valcambi Gold Bar – In Assay, now available for purchase.
The 100-gram Valcambi gold bar produced by Valcambi Suisse is your opportunity to get your hands on a unique and high-quality gold bar. The Valcambi 100 Gram gold bar has an assay card that verifies its purity and metal content to give you peace of mind.
Design of 100 Gram Gold Bar Valcambi – In Assay
The Valcambi refinery is globally known and respected in the bullion industry for its leading design and use of technology to deliver an exceptional product.
The obverse of the 100
Gram Gold bar
Valcambi has a revolving square logo of Valcambi Suisse on the top, followed by engraving the metal content, purity weight, assayer’s stamp, and serial number. The reverse of the bar features just the name of the refinery, “Valcambi Suisse,” in the text, covering a significant portion of the bar.
Main Highlights of 100 Gram Gold Bar Valcambi – In Assay
Manufactured by the Valcambi Suisse
The 100 Grams (3.215 Troy oz) gold bar is of .9999 fine gold.
The bar is sealed in blister-proof packaging, along with the assay card.
The obverse of the bar is engraved with the Valcambi logo followed by weight, purity, assayer’s stamp, and unique serial number.
The reverse of the bar only has the name of the refinery
